pages.title: Flower at the top
pages.text: Grows in a pot in the house atop a $(l:forest/titan_tree)Titan Tree$(/l). It is found nowhere else.

pages.title: Faster growth
pages.text: Planted on the ground, the flower speeds up the growth of every plant within $(thing)20 blocks$(): crops, saplings, stalks, berry bushes.$(br2)If you break it, it drops as an item. You need not leave it where you found it.
